cards.name: Goblin
cards.description: Fast melee fighter.
cards.lore: Once the cannon fodder of orc warbands, goblins discovered they actually enjoy being first through the door.

cards.name: Archer
cards.description: Ranged — fires over walls.
cards.lore: "I don't miss." — Every archer, right before missing.

cards.name: Barbarian
cards.description: Hard-hitting melee fighter.
cards.lore: Trained by no one, feared by everyone. Mostly feared because of the screaming.

cards.name: Knight
cards.description: Armored frontline tank.
cards.lore: The kingdom's finest. Polished armour hides a spectacular collection of bruises.

cards.name: Wizard
cards.description: Magic bypasses walls.
cards.lore: Years of magical study. Thousands of gold in reagents. Wages still less than a goblin.

cards.name: Dragon
cards.description: Unstoppable aerial might.
cards.lore: When it speaks, kingdoms listen. When it breathes, kingdoms burn.

cards.name: Stone Wall
cards.description: Blocks melee units.
cards.lore: The first answer to every problem. Usually the second answer too.

cards.name: Farm
cards.description: +1 max mana. Upgrade: +1 more mana.
cards.lore: Food is mana. Mana is power. This farmer has no idea what he's contributing to.

cards.name: Mana Spring
cards.description: Mana regenerates 50% faster. Upgrade: another +50%.
cards.lore: Nobody can explain where the water comes from. Nobody is asking anymore.

cards.name: Healer's Hut
cards.description: Heals all friendly units 3 HP every 8s. Upgrade: heals every 4s.
cards.lore: "Rest," she says. "It'll hurt less tomorrow." She is usually right.

cards.name: Stone Mason
cards.description: Repairs all friendly walls & structures 8 HP every 10s. Upgrade: every 5s.
cards.lore: Builds walls by day, repairs them by night. He's given up asking why they keep breaking.

cards.name: Blacksmith
cards.description: All friendly units deal +2 damage. Upgrade: +2 more.
cards.lore: Hammer, anvil, fire. In that order. He has opinions about everything else.

cards.name: Barracks
cards.description: Spawns a Goblin every 7s.
cards.lore: Turns gold into goblins. Economists are still debating whether that's profitable.

cards.name: Arcane Tower
cards.description: Spawns an Archer every 12s.
cards.lore: The archers it trains insist they learned everything naturally.

cards.name: Dragon Lair
cards.description: Spawns a Dragon every 25s.
cards.lore: Do not approach. Do not inquire. Absolutely do not ask about the rent.

cards.name: Sharpen Blades
cards.description: All your units gain +2 attack.
cards.lore: The whetstone whine echoes across camp. Everyone quietly checks their grip.

cards.name: Fortify
cards.description: Heal all your units for 8 HP.
cards.lore: "Walk it off." — Official battle doctrine.

cards.name: Skeleton
cards.description: Frail but lightning-fast melee.
cards.lore: Died once, but keeps showing up. Very dedicated.

cards.name: Troll
cards.description: Massive melee brute. Very slow.
cards.lore: You'll know it's coming. You'll have plenty of time to not do anything about it.

cards.name: Crossbow
cards.description: Ranged soldier — fires over walls.
cards.lore: A technically superior weapon. The operators will tell you at every opportunity.

cards.name: Paladin
cards.description: Holy knight — armored and mighty.
cards.lore: Righteous, armoured, and absolutely insufferable at dinner.

cards.name: Rogue
cards.description: Climbs over walls at 25 % speed.
cards.lore: "What wall?" — The Rogue, from the other side of the wall.

cards.name: Catapult
cards.description: Extreme range. Fires over everything.
cards.lore: Technically pacifist. It's the rocks that do the violence.

cards.name: Werewolf
cards.description: Climbs over walls. Ferocious speed.
cards.lore: Formerly a reasonable accountant.

cards.name: Golem
cards.description: Stone titan — massive HP and damage.
cards.lore: Was told to hold the line. Has been holding it for two hundred years.

cards.name: Pixie
cards.description: Tiny and flying — bypasses all walls.
cards.lore: Shoots first, asks never.

cards.name: Ogre
cards.description: Hulking melee powerhouse.
cards.lore: Large. Loud. Effective. Not necessarily in that order.

cards.name: Crypt
cards.description: Spawns a Skeleton every 7s.
cards.lore: Nobody asked what's in there. Everyone agrees not to.

cards.name: Troll Den
cards.description: Spawns a Troll every 20s.
cards.lore: Smells terrible. Keeps the neighbours away.

cards.name: Garrison
cards.description: Spawns a Crossbow every 10s.
cards.lore: A crossbow and a grudge, supplied on rotation.

cards.name: Cathedral
cards.description: Spawns a Paladin every 25s.
cards.lore: Blessed walls. Blessed warriors. Blessed inconvenient for the enemy.

cards.name: Rogue Den
cards.description: Spawns a Rogue every 9s.
cards.lore: No sign. No address. Impossible to miss.

cards.name: Siege Works
cards.description: Spawns a Catapult every 28s.
cards.lore: The engineers here have never met a wall they didn't want to destroy.

cards.name: Dark Shrine
cards.description: Spawns a Werewolf every 14s.
cards.lore: Full moon schedule posted on the door.

cards.name: Iron Forge
cards.description: Spawns a Golem every 35s.
cards.lore: Hammers day and night. Nobody sleeps within a mile.

cards.name: Fairy Ring
cards.description: Spawns a Pixie every 7s.
cards.lore: "Step inside the ring," they said. "It'll be fun," they said.

cards.name: Ogre Den
cards.description: Spawns an Ogre every 16s.
cards.lore: Listed as "residential" in the tax records.

cards.name: Rally
cards.description: Heal all your units for 4 HP.
cards.lore: A rousing speech, a quick bandage — good as new.

cards.name: Haste
cards.description: All your units gain +12 speed.
cards.lore: Legs moved so fast they filed a formal complaint.

cards.name: Iron Skin
cards.description: All your units gain +15 max HP.
cards.lore: Toughen up. Literally.

cards.name: Eagle Eye
cards.description: All your units gain +25 attack range.
cards.lore: See further. Regret it only slightly more often.

cards.name: War Drums
cards.description: All your units gain +5 attack.
cards.lore: The rhythm of violence.

cards.name: Bloodlust
cards.description: All your units surge with furious speed.
cards.lore: Faster. Angrier. Marginally more coordinated.

cards.name: Plague Rat
cards.description: Swarm melee. Incredibly fast attack speed.
cards.lore: One is an annoyance. A hundred is a catastrophe.

cards.name: Bandit
cards.description: Fast climber — scales over walls.
cards.lore: Honest work never paid this well.

cards.name: Bat
cards.description: Tiny flier — ignores walls entirely.
cards.lore: Hung upside down until called upon — a skill with surprising tactical applications.

cards.name: Scorpion
cards.description: Sturdy melee with decent punch.
cards.lore: Armoured, venomous, grumpy. Triple threat.

cards.name: Shield Guard
cards.description: Immovable melee wall — extreme HP.
cards.lore: Move? Why would I move?

cards.name: Centaur
cards.description: Fast ranged — fires over walls.
cards.lore: The upper half writes poetry. The lower half doesn't know.

cards.name: Harpy
cards.description: Flying ranged — swoops over walls and shoots.
cards.lore: Sings beautifully. Fights savagely. Never at the same time.

cards.name: Specter
cards.description: Flying melee — phases through walls.
cards.lore: Died defending the post. Still defending it.

cards.name: Lizardman
cards.description: Climbing melee brawler.
cards.lore: Cold-blooded. Professionally and personally.

cards.name: Ballista
cards.description: Siege bolt — extreme range, fires over walls.
cards.lore: "Fire the ballista!" — said with far too much enthusiasm every time.

cards.name: Vampire
cards.description: Flying melee predator — ignores walls.
cards.lore: Charming until the biting starts. Sometimes also during the biting.

cards.name: Griffin
cards.description: Flying ranged — powerful aerial attacker.
cards.lore: Half eagle, half lion, all opinion.

cards.name: Fire Mage
cards.description: Glass cannon — scorches enemies through walls.
cards.lore: Extremely dangerous. Mostly to itself.

cards.name: Executioner
cards.description: Devastating melee blow — one hit, one kill.
cards.lore: Does not like being told there is more than one swing allowed.

cards.name: Mammoth
cards.description: Armored beast — crushes through melee lines.
cards.lore: Once a peaceful grazer. Someone put armour on it.

cards.name: Dark Elf
cards.description: Ranged climber — scales walls then snipes.
cards.lore: Watches from the shadows. Shoots from the shadows. Lives in the shadows. Hates dentist appointments.

cards.name: Necromancer
cards.description: Long-range magic — bypasses walls.
cards.lore: Death is just unemployment with extra steps.

cards.name: Giant
cards.description: Towering brute — enormous HP and damage.
cards.lore: Slow. Inevitable. Cannot open doors, but rarely needs to.

cards.name: Wyvern
cards.description: Fast flying ranged — dominates from the air.
cards.lore: The dragon's practical cousin. Less fire, more punctuality.

cards.name: Behemoth
cards.description: Ultimate melee titan — nearly unstoppable.
cards.lore: There is no plan B for a Behemoth. There is often no plan A left either.

cards.name: Rat Burrow
cards.description: Spawns a Plague Rat every 5s.
cards.lore: The smell announces them long before they arrive.

cards.name: Bandit Camp
cards.description: Spawns a Bandit every 8s.
cards.lore: Technically a business.

cards.name: Bat Cave
cards.description: Spawns a Bat every 6s.
cards.lore: Dark inside. Dark outside. Mostly just dark.

cards.name: Scorpion Pit
cards.description: Spawns a Scorpion every 9s.
cards.lore: HR has filed fourteen complaints about working conditions.

cards.name: Guard Post
cards.description: Spawns a Shield Guard every 16s.
cards.lore: Stand and deliver. Mostly stand.

cards.name: Centaur Stable
cards.description: Spawns a Centaur every 12s.
cards.lore: It's not a stable, they keep insisting.

cards.name: Harpy Roost
cards.description: Spawns a Harpy every 12s.
cards.lore: Do not look up.

cards.name: Spirit Well
cards.description: Spawns a Specter every 10s.
cards.lore: The water is fine. The spirits are not.

cards.name: Lizard Warren
cards.description: Spawns a Lizardman every 11s.
cards.lore: Warm, underground, and excellent acoustics.

cards.name: Ballista Tower
cards.description: Spawns a Ballista every 15s.
cards.lore: The elevator is broken. Engineers don't care.

cards.name: Vamp. Coven
cards.description: Spawns a Vampire every 14s.
cards.lore: Meets at midnight. Dress code: dramatic.

cards.name: Aerie
cards.description: Spawns a Griffin every 20s.
cards.lore: Spectacular view. Treacherous access. Worth it.

cards.name: Mage Tower
cards.description: Spawns a Fire Mage every 18s.
cards.lore: Full of books, experiments, and extremely anxious junior mages.

cards.name: Gallows
cards.description: Spawns an Executioner every 20s.
cards.lore: Structural integrity questionable. Attendance mandatory.

cards.name: Mammoth Pen
cards.description: Spawns a Mammoth every 25s.
cards.lore: Do not feed after dark. Do not feed before dark either.

cards.name: Shadow Academy
cards.description: Spawns a Dark Elf every 15s.
cards.lore: Curriculum: archery, shadows, and sighing at lesser beings.

cards.name: Death Tower
cards.description: Spawns a Necromancer every 18s.
cards.lore: The door is unlocked. Nobody goes in uninvited.

cards.name: Giant's Hall
cards.description: Spawns a Giant every 45s.
cards.lore: The ceiling keeps getting raised.

cards.name: Wyvern Roost
cards.description: Spawns a Wyvern every 28s.
cards.lore: Perched atop the cliff where nothing else dares to live.

cards.name: Ancient Altar
cards.description: Spawns a Behemoth every 70s.
cards.lore: Old beyond memory. Hungry beyond measure.

cards.name: Field Medic
cards.description: Heal all your units for 6 HP.
cards.lore: Not a real medic. Effective anyway.

cards.name: Titan Blood
cards.description: All your units gain +20 max HP.
cards.lore: Thick. Extremely thick.

cards.name: Sniper Scope
cards.description: All your units gain +30 attack range.
cards.lore: For those who believe range is the solution to all problems.

cards.name: Battle Cry
cards.description: All your units gain +3 attack.
cards.lore: Loud. Effective. No subtlety whatsoever.

cards.name: Vine Golem
cards.description: Slow forest brute — twisted vines for fists.
cards.lore: The forest did not build it. The forest became it.

cards.name: Spore Bat
cards.description: Fast flying swarm — ignores walls.
cards.lore: Releases a cloud of confusion before the claws arrive.

cards.name: Thornbeast
cards.description: Climbing beast covered in razor thorns.
cards.lore: Whatever it used to be, the forest has claimed it fully.

cards.name: Elder Treant
cards.description: Ancient forest titan — near-unstoppable.
cards.lore: It has been here since before the Fracture. It plans to be here after.

cards.name: Frog Knight
cards.description: Leaps over walls. Surprisingly armored.
cards.lore: Somehow obtained full plate armour. Nobody asked where.

cards.name: Thornwall
cards.description: Reinforced thorn barrier — tougher than stone.
cards.lore: The thorns grow back faster than you can cut them.

cards.name: Ancient Grove
cards.description: Spawns a Vine Golem every 18s.
cards.lore: Old enough to remember when the forest covered everything.

cards.name: Ironclad Guard
cards.description: Heavily armored — barely moves, never falls.
cards.lore: Has never retreated. Has never needed to.

cards.name: War Drummer
cards.description: Rallies the march — steady melee brawler.
cards.lore: The beat sets the pace. The pace sets the outcome.

cards.name: Siege Engineer
cards.description: Ranged expert — fires over walls from distance.
cards.lore: Turns distance into an advantage. Turns walls into a suggestion.

cards.name: Shield Wall Soldier
cards.description: Cheap tanky frontliner — absorbs punishment.
cards.lore: The first to arrive. The last to fall. Usually the first to fall.

cards.name: Grizzled Veteran
cards.description: Battle-hardened warrior — reliable and deadly.
cards.lore: Has survived things that should not be survivable. Very annoyed about it.

cards.name: Armory
cards.description: Spawns an Ironclad Guard every 14s.
cards.lore: Every soldier who leaves here is better armed. Most come back.

cards.name: Command Tent
cards.description: +1 max mana. The iron citadel runs on logistics.
cards.lore: Where strategy happens. Mostly arguing, but strategy.

cards.name: Bone Archer
cards.description: Undead ranged — fires through walls.
cards.lore: Accuracy improves significantly without the burden of a heartbeat.

cards.name: Wight Knight
cards.description: Armored undead — relentless and hard to kill.
cards.lore: The armour corrodes. The knight does not.

cards.name: Ash Elemental
cards.description: Flying scorched spirit — burns through all defenses.
cards.lore: Born from the Fracture's scorched aftermath. Still burning.

cards.name: Revenant
cards.description: Fast flying ghost — refuses to stay dead.
cards.lore: Kept returning until everyone stopped asking why.

cards.name: Lich Apprentice
cards.description: Ranged dark magic — bypasses walls.
cards.lore: Still learning. Still deadly. The tuition is paid in souls.

cards.name: Bone Wall
cards.description: Skeletal barrier — sturdier than it looks.
cards.lore: Unpleasant to look at. Effective to hide behind.

cards.name: Soul Obelisk
cards.description: Spawns a Revenant every 11s.
cards.lore: Whispers things. Nobody agrees on what.

cards.name: Arcane Golem
cards.description: Heavy arcane construct. Slow but devastating.
cards.lore: Crystallised from raw ley-line energy. It doesn't think. It doesn't need to.

cards.name: Mana Wisp
cards.description: Fast ranged magic — bypasses walls.
cards.lore: A fragment of raw mana given just enough awareness to be annoying.

cards.name: Rune Knight
cards.description: Armored melee fighter inscribed with protective runes.
cards.lore: Every rune was carved by hand. He felt every one of them.

cards.name: Spellblade
cards.description: Fast melee fighter with arcane-enhanced strikes.
cards.lore: Half sword technique, half arcane theory. Fully dangerous.

cards.name: Crystal Hydra
cards.description: Multi-headed arcane beast. Ranged, bypasses walls.
cards.lore: Each head was once a separate experiment. The merger was unintentional.

cards.name: Mana Tower
cards.description: +1 max mana. Channels ley-line energy.
cards.lore: Taps directly into the Spire's mana grid. The Archivist has filed several complaints about this.

cards.name: Crystal Wall
cards.description: Blocks melee units. Sturdier than stone.
cards.lore: Grown, not built. The Spire's lattice does not distinguish between wall and corridor.

cards.name: Leyline Node
cards.description: Mana regenerates 50% faster.
cards.lore: An intersection of ley lines, tapped and stabilised. Mostly stabilised.

cards.name: Mana Surge
cards.description: All your units gain +3 attack.
cards.lore: Flood your units with raw mana. The side effects are someone else's problem.

cards.name: Arcane Efficiency
cards.description: Heal all your units for 7 HP.
cards.lore: Optimal resource usage. The Archivist has seventeen papers on the subject.

cards.name: Dryad Sentinel
cards.description: Ranged forest guardian — her arrows find gaps in any wall.
cards.lore: She does not fight for the forest. She is the forest's will made arrow.

cards.name: Mushroom Hulk
cards.description: Massive fungal brute — slow but nearly unstoppable.
cards.lore: The spores are not a side effect. They are the point.

cards.name: Pixie Scout
cards.description: Tiny flying scout — fast, fragile, and surprisingly vicious.
cards.lore: Never trust anything that fits in your ear.

cards.name: Swamp Lurker
cards.description: Slimy ambush predator — bypasses walls by going under them.
cards.lore: The swamp does not give back what it takes.

cards.name: Moss Golem
cards.description: Ancient armoured colossus — centuries of moss and spite.
cards.lore: It was not built in a day. Or a year. Or a century.

cards.name: Spore Tower
cards.description: Periodically launches a Spore Bat at the enemy.
cards.lore: The tower does not stop. Not for weather. Not for war.

cards.name: Mushroom Circle
cards.description: Regenerates nearby units with fungal energy.
cards.lore: Step inside. Don't ask what the spores do.

cards.name: Root Network
cards.description: Ancient root system — draws mana from the earth each turn.
cards.lore: Every tree in the shard is connected. You just tapped in.

cards.name: Overgrowth
cards.description: All units toughened by forest growth — gain 12 max HP.
cards.lore: The forest heals what it does not consume.

cards.name: Nature's Bounty
cards.description: Restore 10 HP to all your units.
cards.lore: The land provides. Even here.

cards.name: Spore Cloud
cards.description: Spores energise all units — gain +8 move speed.
cards.lore: It's probably not toxic. Probably.

cards.name: Root Bind
cards.description: Forest spirits extend the reach of all your units by 20.
cards.lore: Roots reach further than you think.

cards.name: Wild Surge
cards.description: The wild answers — all units gain +4 attack.
cards.lore: The Verdant Shard does not negotiate.

cards.name: Battering Ram Crew
cards.description: Slow siege crew — prioritises destroying walls.
cards.lore: They have never met a gate they couldn't open.

cards.name: Cavalry Scout
cards.description: Fast mounted scout — harasses weak ranged units.
cards.lore: Speed is armour. Most of the time.

cards.name: Demolitions Expert
cards.description: High burst damage — ignores walls, destroys them first.
cards.lore: Explosives are a planning tool. Mostly.

cards.name: Sappers
cards.description: Tunnellers — bypass walls, target enemy buildings.
cards.lore: You can't defend what you can't find.

cards.name: Ballista Crew
cards.description: Long-range siege archers — bypass walls, devastate large units.
cards.lore: Precision, patience, penetration.

cards.name: Siege Tower
cards.description: Elevated fortification — boosts nearby unit attack by 2.
cards.lore: Height is an advantage. Build higher.

cards.name: Fortified Wall
cards.description: Iron-reinforced wall — twice the HP of a stone wall.
cards.lore: Iron holds. Stone merely delays.

cards.name: Moat
cards.description: Water barrier — slowly repairs nearby walls.
cards.lore: The water doesn't stop them. The mud does.

cards.name: Battle Hardened
cards.description: Veterans of the Citadel — all units gain 10 max HP.
cards.lore: Scars are scar tissue. Scar tissue is armour.

cards.name: Iron Discipline
cards.description: Drill and discipline — all units gain +2 attack.
cards.lore: The Iron Citadel doesn't breed heroes. It breeds soldiers.

cards.name: Siege Protocol
cards.description: Tactical positioning — all units gain +20 attack range.
cards.lore: Engage from distance. Dictate the terms.

cards.name: Tactical Retreat
cards.description: Regroup and recover — restore 8 HP to all units.
cards.lore: Retreat is not defeat. It is preparation.

cards.name: Shadow Stalker
cards.description: Undead infiltrator — bypasses walls, targets buildings.
cards.lore: You feel it before you see it. Then you don't see anything at all.

cards.name: Soulrend Witch
cards.description: Dark ranged caster — magically bypasses defences.
cards.lore: She does not cast spells. She tears them out of the world.

cards.name: Bone Colossus
cards.description: Titanic undead siege unit — destroys walls, shrugs off arrows.
cards.lore: It is not one skeleton. It is all of them.

cards.name: Wraith
cards.description: Flying undead spirit — ignores walls, phases through defences.
cards.lore: The cold you feel is not the temperature. It is the memory of warmth.

cards.name: Death Altar
cards.description: Continuously raises weak skeletons from fallen enemies.
cards.lore: Death is not the end here. It is the beginning of service.

cards.name: Necrotic Pool
cards.description: Foul energy restores undead units nearby.
cards.lore: The smell is not decay. It is potential.

cards.name: Graveblight Tower
cards.description: Raises powerful Revenants from the grave at intervals.
cards.lore: The tower remembers everyone who has ever died near it.

cards.name: Undying Rage
cards.description: Death fuels fury — all units gain +4 attack.
cards.lore: They fight harder when they have nothing left to lose.

cards.name: Soul Harvest
cards.description: Drain life energy — restore 8 HP to all units.
cards.lore: The Ashen Wastes give back. Eventually.

cards.name: Plague Spread
cards.description: Plague-driven frenzy — all units gain +10 move speed.
cards.lore: Even the dying don't stop moving.

cards.name: Dark Ritual
cards.description: Forbidden rite — all units gain 20 max HP and are healed for it.
cards.lore: The price is someone else's.

cards.name: Entropy Wave
cards.description: Unleash pure entropy — all units gain +8 attack.
cards.lore: Everything falls apart. You just decided what falls apart first.

cards.name: Techno Imp
cards.description: Tiny flying construct — fast and annoying in numbers.
cards.lore: Someone thought this was a good idea. They were not wrong.

cards.name: Mana Siphon
cards.description: Ranged magic drainer — bypasses walls, feeds off mana.
cards.lore: It doesn't attack you. It drains you. Same outcome.

cards.name: Arcane Turret
cards.description: Stationary magic cannon — devastating ranged fire.
cards.lore: Immovable. Implacable. Inadvisable to stand near.

cards.name: Void Elemental
cards.description: Flying void creature — phases through walls, medium ranged.
cards.lore: It does not come from nowhere. It comes from the space between things.

cards.name: Chronomancer
cards.description: Time-manipulating mage — fast attack speed, magical bypass.
cards.lore: It has already won. It's being polite by playing it out.

cards.name: Arcane Forge
cards.description: Magical enchantment forge — boosts nearby unit attack by 3.
cards.lore: It doesn't make weapons. It makes weapons angry.

cards.name: Null Field
cards.description: Arcane disruption field — mana recharges 50% faster.
cards.lore: It nullifies everything except mana. That was intentional.

cards.name: Crystal Resonance
cards.description: Crystal harmonics amplify unit power — all gain +3 attack.
cards.lore: The Spire hums. Those who can hear it hum louder.

cards.name: Void Tap
cards.description: Tap into the void — all units gain +15 move speed.
cards.lore: Void energy has side effects. None of them are boring.

cards.name: Temporal Loop
cards.description: Rewind time on your units — all gain 25 max HP and are healed.
cards.lore: They have survived this battle before. They will again.

heroCards.name: Dragon Lord
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a mighty Dragon & grants all units +6 attack!
heroCards.lore: Commands dragons. Dragons pretend not to notice.

heroCards.name: Battle Queen
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys an armored Paladin & fortifies all units with +20 max HP!
heroCards.lore: Won sixteen wars. Lost zero negotiations.

heroCards.name: Storm Caller
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a fearsome Wyvern & blesses all units with +40 attack range!
heroCards.lore: The sky does what she says. Eventually.

heroCards.name: Shadow King
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a savage Werewolf & surges all units with +25 speed!
heroCards.lore: Feared in twelve kingdoms. Banned from two taverns specifically.

heroCards.name: Death Lord
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a sinister Lich Apprentice who summons a skeleton army & hastens all units with -500ms attack cooldown!
heroCards.lore: Death is just a job. A very grim job, but somebody's got to do it.

heroCards.name: Forest Guardian
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a mighty Elder Treant & rejuvenates all units with +4 HP heal every 10s!
heroCards.lore: The forest is alive. It has opinions on your strategy.

heroCards.name: Swarm Queen
heroCards.description: HERO: Deploys a mischievous Pixie & commands it to spawn a Spore Bat for you every 10s!
heroCards.lore: The swarm is a family. A very bitey family.

heroCards.name: Graham The All Seeing
heroCards.lore: Sees all. Knows all. Still can't find his keys. Play tested by Graham, who is indeed all seeing.
